study type: Secondary retrospective analysis of a prospective study
exposure: Maximum diameter of the gestational sac
Chorionic villi thickness at the scar
outcome: Success rate of transabdominal ultrasound (TAUS)-guided suction curettage alone for cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP)
Predictive factors for failure of TAUS-guided suction curettage alone
cohort: 137 women diagnosed with CSP who underwent TAUS-guided suction curettage alone for the first time
finding: Maximum diameter of the gestational sac >29 mm, residual myometrium thickness ≤1.8 mm, and chorionic villi thickness at the scar >4.7 mm were independent predictors of failure for TAUS-guided suction curettage alone for CSP.
